ImageDescription.value:
1992 Honda Civic EH5 1.6 saloon in Puchong, Malaysia.
Designed & Assembled in Japan
Note : This Civic variant for the Malaysian market was offered with premium features (considering its age), including all-round power windows, power-folding mirrors, ABS and a driver's airbag. The alloy rims pictured are aftermarket equipment.
